title: Persistent Cross Entropy
abstract: arXiv:2608.24549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Persistent entropy is the Shannon entropy of a persistence-based probability measure defined on a persistence diagram. However, its cross-entropy version is not naturally defined because two persistence diagrams generally have different event spaces. To bridge these event spaces, we combine a similarity function with persistence weighting to define an induced probability. The induced probability reflects information from one diagram on the event space of the other diagram and assigns unexplained probability mass to the unexplained event. Using the induced probability, we extend cross entropy to persistence diagrams, called persistent cross entropy (PCE). We establish the main properties of both the induced probability and PCE and prove stability theorems for both. Through three numerical studies, we show that PCE distinguishes diagrams with the same persistent entropy, separates causal directions in dynamical systems without constructing

translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.24549v1 公告类型：新 摘要：持久熵是定义在持久图上的基于持久性的概率测度的香农熵。然而，其交叉熵版本并非自然定义，因为两个持久图通常具有不同的事件空间。为了桥接这些事件空间，我们将相似性函数与持久加权相结合，以定义诱导概率。诱导概率从一个图在另一个图的事件空间上反映信息，并将未解释的概率质量分配给未解释的事件。利用诱导概率，我们将交叉熵扩展到持久图，称为持久交叉熵（PCE）。我们建立了诱导概率和PCE的主要性质，并证明了二者的稳定性定理。通过三项数值研究，我们展示了PCE能够区分具有相同持久熵的图，并在不构造的情况下分离动态系统中的因果方向。
tldr: 该论文提出持久交叉熵（PCE），通过相似性函数和持久加权桥接不同持久图的事件空间，扩展交叉熵到持久图，并证明其稳定性和区分能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Persistent Cross Entropy (PCE), which bridges event spaces of different persistence diagrams using a similarity function and persistence weighting, extends cross entropy to persistence diagrams, and proves its stability and discriminative power.
